# EDUCATION

```{r EDUCATION}
edu %>%
  detailed_entries(
    with = inst,
    what = degree,
    why = detail,
    when = glue::glue("{startYear} --> {endYear}",.na = ""),
    where = where
  )
```

# PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS

```{r CERTIFICATIONS}
certifications %>%
  detailed_entries(
    with = certBody,
    what = accomplishment,
    why = detail,
    when = year,
    where = where
  )
```
